items.title: Side panes really open
items.text: When an agent says it opened a side pane, it's in your window. Pane names now belong to their window, so another session's "draft" pane is no longer reused somewhere you can't see.

items.title: +split reports what actually happened
items.text: The command answers after the pane exists: its id and window, whether it opened minimized, or a real error if it didn't open.

items.title: A side pane always comes on show
items.text: In a half-screen window, a pane an agent opens beside you comes on show instead of being born a strip. Your caret stays put.

items.title: Lighter ghoztty skill
items.text: The skill loads a short core (side panes, new window, close, banners, send-keys) and reads the rest only when needed. Re-install it from Ghoztty's setup to pick this up.

items.title: Names resolve in your own window first
items.text: +close, +send-keys, +read, +set-banner and friends look a name up in the caller's window first. A name held by several other windows is an error that points at the pane id, never a random pick.
